title: Nylon V1 (338M)
shortDescription: Compact autoregressive language model pretrained from scratch on 5.36B tokens and aligned with SFT and DPO, runnable locally via Ollama.

trainingStages.results: Train Loss: 1.0666 · Validation Loss: 2.1804 · Validation Perplexity: 8.8498
Train Loss: 0.0004 · Validation Loss: 1.10 · Validation Perplexity: 3.0042
trainingStages.budget: Strict persona attribution & verifiable code reasoning

trainingStages.results: Eval DPO Loss: 0.6447 · Eval Accuracy: 64.0% · Reward Margin: 1.1143

engineeringHighlights: Pretrained a 337.96M parameter GPT-2 stack on 5.36B tokens across 2× RTX 5090s for under $100 compute budget (41.1k tok/s).
Aligned via SFT (val PPL 3.00) and DPO; released quantized GGUF weights runnable locally via Ollama.
whatWasDone: Architected the Nylon V1 model spec: 24-layer Pre-LayerNorm transformer with 16 attention heads, 1024 hidden dimension, 4096 MLP dimension, tied input/output embeddings, and PyTorch 2.8 FlashAttention (SDPA).
Curated and preprocessed a 5.36-billion-token multi-domain corpus spanning code, mathematics, and technical literature.

Engineered the distributed training harness across dual RTX 5090 GPUs (31.36 GB VRAM each) with AdamW optimization, cosine warmup-decay scheduling (1e-4 to 3e-5), gradient clipping at 1.0, and 16-step effective gradient accumulation.
Executed supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated multi-turn dialogue with strict persona attribution and code reasoning across 4,329 steps.
Performed Direct Preference Optimization (DPO, beta=0.1) across 8,841 optimization steps, achieving an evaluation reward margin of 1.1143 and eval accuracy of 64%.
Exported model weights to GGUF format and published to the Hugging Face Hub under enigmare/nylon-v1.

title: Nylon-Tokenizer
category: AI Systems · Subword Tokenization · Technical Report
shortDescription: Hardware-aligned byte-level BPE with domain-aware pretokenization for compact language models.
pipeline: 501.2 MB Multi-Domain Corpus → Domain Pretokenization Regex → Inverted Pair Index (52.79s) → V=65,536 uint16 Shards
engineeringHighlights: Co-designed vocabulary strictly to V = 65,536, enabling native uint16 serialization that halves 120B-token storage from 480 GB to 240 GB and doubles page-cache token residency.
Domain-aware pretokenization preserves atomic decimal place boundaries (1.00 BPT), compresses code indentation up to 8.0x, and eliminates UTF-8 fragmentation in African tonal languages.
Affected-sequence BPE induction tracks pair updates with an inverted index, completing all 65,266 merges across 501.2 MB text in 52.79 seconds.
whatWasDone: Co-designed Nylon-Tokenizer with a strict V = 65,536 vocabulary boundary, enabling native uint16 integer serialization on memory-mapped disk shards.
Curated a balanced 501.2 MB multi-domain induction corpus across FineWeb-Edu (40%), UltraChat (25%), Open-Web-Math (15%), The Stack (15%), and tool calling schemas (5%).

Implemented domain-aware pretokenization with atomic single-digit isolation (1.00 BPT), greedy indentation runs (8, 4, 2 spaces), and Unicode NFC normalization for African languages (Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo).
Engineered affected-sequence BPE induction using an inverted pair-to-sequence index, bounding merge update complexity and completing 65,266 merges in 52.79s.

Conducted extensive intrinsic ablation benchmarks demonstrating that removing Unicode pretokenization drops multilingual compression by 16.5% and removing indentation rules drops code compression by 15.0%.

title: Nova Agent

pipeline: OODA loop → tool execution → memory → recovery

Engineered parallel task execution using Node.js worker threads and Piscina.
whatWasDone: Built a high-performance autonomous agent capable of executing complex multi-step workflows locally with minimal supervision.
Integrated a continuous OODA loop enabling real-time recovery and adaptive decision-making upon tool failures.
Engineered parallel worker execution via Piscina for simultaneous browsing, scripting, and API communication.
Designed a Markdown-first persistent memory architecture storing long-term goals, execution history, and context safely.
Packaged the engine as an open-source npm module with CLI interface and WebSocket server for external client integration.

title: Always Secure

pipeline: Client AES-256 encrypt → ephemeral Redis store → burn-on-read
engineeringHighlights: Implemented client-side AES-256 encryption using Web Crypto API before data leaves browser.

whatWasDone: Constructed a zero-knowledge security tool guaranteeing zero plaintext access on the server.
